Project Svarog: Solar Sail Mission at ICSS

Part of the orbital mechanics team at the Imperial College Space Society, I contributed to Project Svarog — a CubeSat with a solar sail set on a trajectory to interstellar space, targeting a 2028 launch window.

  • Focus: orbital mechanics, atmospheric drag, relativistic effects
  • Tools: Julia
